Journey_Title: Vehicle Trade-in Appraisal — Lead → Valuation → Approval → (Inspection / Inventory / Opportunity Line Item)
Pre_Requisites: Auto_Appraisal_Config_UJ + Auto_Appraisal_Data_UJ + Auto_Appraisal_Integration_UJ + Auto_Appraisal_Reporting_UJ all completed (or roll-up Setup_All).
Business_Process: Appraisal Interest Capture → VIN search / manual entry → Vehicle Condition + Features capture → External multi-provider valuation → Negotiation & adjustments → Approval → Inspection Visit (256) → Inventory hand-off (256) → Opportunity / Lead Line Item link (256) → Reporting refresh
Detailed_Scenarios:
Scenario Overview: A walk-in customer at a dealership wants to trade in their existing vehicle (VIN known) toward a new car. The Dealer Sales Executive captures the trade-in interest from the open Lead, runs the Appraisal flow end-to-end through valuation, multi-provider price comparison, adjustments, Finance Manager approval, schedules an Inspection Visit (256), updates the appraisal price, gets it approved & communicated, and finally adds the appraised vehicle to inventory and links it to the Opportunity Line Item (256).

This journey mirrors the Process Flow diagram in the Epic ('Appraisal Management High Level Design').

Step-by-Step:
1. [Dealer Sales Executive] Opens the existing Lead (Person Account with Lead Line Item already captured).
   - Pre-req row: Setup-Data step 15 (Lead + Lead Line Item).
   - Action: from Lead page, clicks 'New Appraisal' (custom action exposed by Auto_Appraisal_Config_UJ step 23). FlexCard launches the Appraisal OmniScript (Vehicle flow).
2. [Dealer Sales Executive] Selects Interest Type = 'Trade-in' (Epic Detailed Description Epic 1 / Epic 3).
   - System validates Interest Type drives downstream UI: Trade-in shows Customer Asking Price; Valuation hides it; Sales reuses Trade-in path with no Opportunity link.
3. [Dealer Sales Executive] Selects Asset Type = 'Vehicle' (per Epic 3 — model the Appraisal flexibility from different pages or asset types).
4. [Dealer Sales Executive] Step 'Search by VIN#' — enters customer-supplied VIN (Process Flow first decision).
   - [System] Looks up Vehicle table → match found → auto-populates Make, Model, Year, Style/Trim, License Plate + State, last odometer Mileage, Wrranty End Date (from Asset Warranty linkage). Pre-req row: Setup-Data steps 11 + 13.
   - Negative path: VIN not found → flow branches to 'Manually entry of Vehicle details' per Process Flow (Step 4b below).
4b. [Dealer Sales Executive] Manual entry path: License Plate + State, Make, Model, Year (picklists wired to Vehicle Definition; pre-req row Setup-Data step 10), Style.
5. [Dealer Sales Executive] Step 'Vehicle Condition Capture' — selects Condition picklist (Excellent / Good / Average / Rough), Exterior Colour picklist, Mileage + Mileage UoM, Owner / hand-off count, Damage History notes (Appraisal Notes text area), Modifications done (checkbox), Additional equipments on the vehicle (checkbox → expands AccessoryProduct picker).
   - Pre-req row: Setup-Data steps 4–7 + step 14 (AccessoryProduct).
6. [Dealer Sales Executive] Step 'Vehicle Features Capture' — picks accessories (rooftop, leather seats, sound system) from AccessoryProduct list. Each selected accessory writes an Appraisal Accessories row (Accessory Name, Accessory Price, Related Product, Related Appraisal).
7. [Dealer Sales Executive] Step 'Customer Asking Price' — enters the price the customer asked for (currency).
8. [System] On 'Get Valuation' click, OmniScript Integration Procedure fans out to all configured external valuation providers (per Auto_Appraisal_Integration_UJ step 1).
   - [System] Persists one Appraisal Item Provider Valuation row per provider per request (Market Source, Market Price Date, Validity, Trade-in Value, Auction Value, Retail Value, Average / Rough / Clean Condition Value).
   - Telemetry counter 'Number of Appraisal Valuations created' increments by N.
   - Negative path: provider returns 5xx → row absent for that provider; FlexCard surfaces 'Retry' affordance; dealer can proceed with available providers.
9. [Dealer Sales Executive] Reviews provider valuations side-by-side on the Vehicle Valuation FlexCard, picks the working baseline (e.g., KBB Average).
   - System pre-fills Initial Appraisal Price = chosen provider value (or average of providers, per dealer convention).
10. [Dealer Sales Executive] Negotiation loop — adds Appraisal Adjustment rows:
    - Adjustment Type = 'Reconditioning Cost' (-$500), 'Dents and Scratches' (-$200), 'Mark-up Profit Margin' (-$300), 'Markup' for accessory premium (+$100).
    - Each Adjustment Price can be % or absolute (Epic Field doc).
    - System recalculates Adjusted Appraisal Price = Initial Appraisal Price + sum(Adjustment Price).
11. [Dealer Sales Executive] Decision diamond 'Negotiation finalised?'.
    - Path A (Yes — 254 P0 happy path): clicks 'Submit for Approval'.
    - Path B (No, 256): clicks 'Schedule Visit for Inspection' → opens GV Visit (Inspection Visit) with Action Plan Template + Document Checklist Items (per Auto_Appraisal_Integration_UJ steps 3 + 4); Service Advisor inspects → Step 12.
12. [Service Advisor] (256 only) Performs physical / remote inspection; uploads results to Action Plan Items + DocumentChecklistItem; updates Appraisal record fields and Adjustment rows; sets Appraisal Status = 'Inspection Complete'.
13. [Dealer Sales Executive] Path A continues: submits the Appraisal record into the Approval Process (per Auto_Appraisal_Integration_UJ step 2).
    - Telemetry counter 'Number of edits made to Appraisal' increments per save.
14. [Finance Manager] Receives approval email; opens Appraisal record; reviews Adjustment trail and Provider Valuations; approves.
    - [System] Final-step Field Update: Final Appraisal Price = Adjusted Appraisal Price; Status = 'Approved'.
    - Negative path: Finance Manager rejects → Status = 'Rejected'; Dealer Sales Executive returns to Step 10 to revise adjustments and re-submits.
15. [Dealer Sales Executive] Communicates the Approved Appraisal Price to the customer (in-person or via Experience Cloud notification if Customer Community is in scope per Epic 10).
16. [Dealer Sales Executive] Clicks 'Add to Inventory' (Epic 13, R256).
    - [System] Marks Handover Completed = TRUE on the Appraisal record; creates Vehicle Inventory record per Auto_Appraisal_Integration_UJ step 7.
    - Telemetry counter 'Number of Appraisals associated with …' rolls up.
17. [Dealer Sales Executive] Links the appraised vehicle to Opportunity Line Item / Lead Line Item / Quote (Epic 14, R256).
    - Pre-req row: Setup-Data step 16 (Opportunity + Opportunity Product).
18. [System] Reporting refresh:
    - Native 'Appraisals by Status' report reflects 'Approved' (Auto_Appraisal_Reporting_UJ step 3).
    - CRM Analytics Dealer Performance dashboard 'Appraisal Performance' tab reflects approval count and average final price after next dataflow refresh window (Auto_Appraisal_Reporting_UJ step 4).
    - Agentforce 'Summarize appraisal' action returns Customer Asking Price, Initial, Adjusted, Final, Adjustment list, Provider Valuations (Auto_Appraisal_Reporting_UJ step 5).
    - Audit Trail records the Approved transition + Field Update.

Variant scenarios:
- Variant A (P0, 254): Vehicle Trade-in from a Lead, single provider (KBB only), one approver, no Inspection Visit, no Inventory hand-off (Epics 13/14 hidden in 254).
- Variant B (P1, 256): same path but with Inspection Visit + Action Plan + Document Checklist + multi-provider valuation (KBB + JD Power) + Add to Inventory + Opportunity Line Item link.
- Variant C (P1): Asset Trade-in (Battery RT) initiated from Asset Console — uses Asset Appraisal RT, Asset Appraisal Item layout, no License Plate, includes Usage / Usage UoM and Asset Warranty End Date. Pre-req row: Setup-Data step 12.
- Variant D (P2): Customer / Partner Community user creates Appraisal externally (Epic 10) — sharing rule limits visibility to their own record.
- Variant E (P2): Approval cycle time ≥ 1 day (overnight approval) — verifies email re-notification and SLA report.
Features_Mapped: Appraisal, Appraisal Item, Appraisal Adjustment, Appraisal Accessories, Appraisal Item Add-on, Appraisal Item Provider Valuation, Vehicle, Asset, Asset Warranty, Lead + Lead Line Item, Opportunity + Opportunity Product, Account, OmniScript (Vehicle Appraisal flow), FlexCards (Appraisal + Appraisal Item), Approval Process, External Valuation Adapter (KBB / JD Power / Black Book / Manheim), Generic Visit Framework (256), Action Plan / Document Checklist Item (256), Field Service Inventory (256), Experience Cloud (Epic 10), Telemetry, Audit Trail, CRM Analytics Dealer Performance, Agentforce for Automotive (optional)
Personas: Dealer Sales Executive (primary; initiator); Finance Manager (approver); Service Advisor (Inspection Visit, 256); Customer (asks for price; receives communication); Partner Community User (external initiator, Epic 10); System (valuation broker, approval Field Update, telemetry, dashboard refresh)
Complexity:
Vehicle Trade-in from Lead, single provider, no inspection - P0 (R254)
Vehicle Trade-in from Lead, multi-provider, with Inspection Visit + Inventory + Opportunity LI - P1 (R256)
Asset Trade-in (Battery / Equipment) from Asset Console - P1
Customer / Partner Community external initiator - P2
Approval reject → re-adjust → re-submit loop - P1
Negative path: VIN not found → manual entry - P0
Negative path: provider 5xx → fallback to remaining providers - P1
Frequency: Daily (per dealership; 1–20 transactions per dealer per day at steady state)
Setup_Required: All four Setup journeys completed; org has at least one Lead with Lead Line Item, one Vehicle with VIN, one Person Account, one Finance Manager approver, one valuation Named Credential active.
Expected_Outcome: Customer trade-in is captured, valued against external providers, adjusted, approved, optionally inspected, optionally added to inventory, and optionally linked to an Opportunity Line Item — all telemetry, audit, and reporting surfaces light up. Approval cycle is closed-loop and observable.
Integration_Points: External Valuation Providers (KBB / JD Power / Black Book / Manheim), Approval / Email, Generic Visit framework (256), Action Plan / Document Checklist (256), Field Service Inventory (256), Experience Cloud (Epic 10), Telemetry, Audit Trail, CRM Analytics, Agentforce (optional)
Performance_Requirements: Search by VIN < 2s; multi-provider valuation fan-out (≤4 providers) end-to-end < 60s; OmniScript step transitions < 1s; approval submit < 5s; approver email delivery < 30s; Add to Inventory < 5s; CRM Analytics dashboard delta within next refresh window (≤24h).
